sources.fullCitation: [Willy Schmidt-Gentner composing the accompaniment for Frau im Mond]. Photograph credited “Phot. Ufa.” Film-Magazin, vereinigt mit Filmwelt (Berlin), vol. 3 (1929), scan leaf 1084. Museum of Modern Art Library copy; Internet Archive / Media History Digital Library.
sources.title: Willy Schmidt-Gentner composing for Frau im Mond
sources.creator: Ufa (photograph credit)
sources.repository: Internet Archive / Media History Digital Library
sources.researchNote: The printed caption identifies “Kapellmeister Willy Schmidt-Gentner” while composing the accompaniment to Ufa’s Fritz Lang film Frau im Mond.

media.title: Willy Schmidt-Gentner — Film-Magazin, 1929
media.description: Willy Schmidt-Gentner composing the accompaniment for Ufa’s Frau im Mond, as captioned in Film-Magazin in 1929. The photograph is credited “Phot. Ufa”.
media.altText: Black-and-white photograph of Willy Schmidt-Gentner in shirtsleeves, writing at a desk in front of a bookcase.
media.publicCaption: Willy Schmidt-Gentner at work, in the photograph printed in Film-Magazin in 1929 under the caption “Kapellmeister Willy Schmidt-Gentner bei der Komposition der Begleitmusik zu dem Fritz-Lang-Film der Ufa „Frau im Mond“”. The picture is credited to Ufa.
media.publicCreditLine: Photograph credited “Phot. Ufa”; Film-Magazin, 1929; Museum of Modern Art Library copy; Media History Digital Library / Internet Archive.
